summary.text: Shaundelle Brooks is the Democratic state representative for Tennessee House District 60, part of Davidson County, who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Brooks earned a bachelor's degree in law and criminal justice from John Jay University and a certification in non-profit management from Tennessee State University.
She has been a member of the House since the 114th General Assembly.
Ballotpedia reports that she faces Republican Eva Romero in the general election.
